findings.claim: The overview tiles re-read the live profile language once per string instead of once per render: proposalsTile calls s.presentation.language() three times (459, 460, 463) and sessionTiles three times (230, 244, 253), each taking the store's RLock separately. A POST /profile switching en->de that lands between two of those reads renders one tile half-translated (e.g. "1 accepted · 1 abgelehnt"). The sibling handlers in this diff already read the language once and pass it down (batchBands(..., language), proposalViews(..., language, ...), sentimentTrend(language, ...)).
findings.evidence: Re-read overview.go 183-259 and 430-466 at 1f725ce: sessionTiles calls s.presentation.language() at 230, 244 and 253; proposalsTile calls it at 459, 460 and 463. presentation.go 69-73: language() takes st.mu.RLock per call, and saveProfileSelection -> reload() swaps st.profile under Lock between calls, so two reads in one render can return different values. sessions.go 168 and proposals.go 181 show the in-diff pattern of passing a single language value into helpers. Not in known.json (tests-NIT-9-r1 covers the missing tile-detail test only).
findings.fix: In handleOverview read language := s.presentation.language() once and pass it into sessionTiles(window, language) and proposalsTile(language), replacing the repeated s.presentation.language() calls.
